messages:
alex: FYI customer (AcmeHealth iOS) hit truncated stream after app background/resume. Swift SDK reconnect left open array, app can't parse. no finish_reason
sam: Ugh. Which SDK version? logs? repro steps?
alex: sdk 1.4.2 (iOS 16). Repro steps: start stream -> background the app -> wait 20s -> foreground -> SDK reconnects and resumes. Customer sees final payload missing final object and trailing comma.
ingrid: Can you paste the raw SSE framing from the device? If possible, wrap in triple backticks
alex: pasted below:
```
data: {"id":"tok_abc","choices":[{"text":"So the answer is ","index":0,"finish_reason":null}]}
data: [
```
that's it — stream ends with open '[' on resume.
jordan: Did they hit auth rotation? token refresh around the same time?
alex: no, token still valid. We did see an upstream keepalive + 204 when backgrounded, then SDK did resume with If-None-Match header? not sure.
sam: Can you try curl repro from device with same resume headers? Also attach SDK debug log level=trace.
alex: curl test (simulating resume):
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test" \\
  -H "Reconnect: resume" \\
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=gpt-mini"
```
results: last lines:
```
data: {"id":"tok_abc","choices":[{"text":"So the answer is ","index":0,"finish_reason":null}]}
data: [
```
no trailing event. parse fails.
ingrid: Server side logs for that session? request id?
alex: req_id=01H9Z7X2. From logs: connection closed by upstream proxy during resume flush; edge-proxy reported 499 client closed request. upstream service returned 200 but proxy trimmed final chunk. attaching snippet: "edge-proxy: client_disconnect during flush, partial_body_sent"
jordan: Sounds like edge proxy or keepalive race with client reconnect header. Could be our resume handler: if upstream already closed stream, we send open-array marker but fail to close.
sam: Steps: (1) Reproduce w/ curl + --keepalive (2) Toggle SDK to buffer final event until ACK from network layer (3) Add server-side guard to append finish token when detecting truncated stream.
alex: Customer needs a mitigation. Can we issue a quick server-side fallback that if stream ends with '[' or trailing comma we append ']' and a finish_reason=\"incomplete\" in the last choice? Or at least return a 2xx with finish_reason=null? They prefer deterministic behavior.
ingrid: Agreed, implement defensive post-process for partial JSON tails on resume code path. I'll file a quick PR to runtime to check for open arrays and close them. Assign to eng-runtime. (in progress)
sam: I'll loop customer: tell them we're deploying a fix to sanitize truncated resume tails; ask them to switch to SDK 1.4.3-beta when ready. :thumbsup: 
replay-bot: Incident created: #INC-2024-342 (edge-proxy resume trimming) assigned to eng-runtime
alex: thanks — keeping customer updated. :pray:
